Website articles, news, newsletters, opinion, and release archives are not in this corpus. Returns bounded exc

tools.name: worlds_get_document
tools.description: Read the bounded public excerpt and metadata for one source-checked CLI manual returned by worlds_search_knowledge. Follow canonical_url for the complete manual. Structured CLI command tools remain complete.

tools.name: worlds_compare_cli_workflows
tools.description: Find evidence for the same task across Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build without pretending their commands or authority models are identical. Returns separately ranked groups with source dates and canonical links. Best for questions such as configuring MCP, repository instructions, approvals, subag

tools.name: worlds_list_catalog
tools.description: Return public corpus counts, supported worlds, languages, products, source-quality counts, the build commit, and the current publication gate. This public DTO deliberately excludes local paths, package names, and private repository URLs.

tools.name: worlds_search_cli_reference
tools.description: Search current command paths, flags, interactive commands, configuration names, environment-variable names, workflows, and release drift for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build. Results contain factual metadata and official source links.

tools.name: worlds_get_cli_command
tools.description: Return one current command path with all captured flags, arguments, value shapes, availability, risk, release metadata, and official source links. Accepts a stable id or full command path.

tools.name: worlds_get_cli_configuration
tools.description: Search configuration keys and environment-variable names for one CLI. Returns public schema metadata and source links, never local values.

tools.name: worlds_get_cli_workflow
tools.description: Find one provider-specific workflow and its recorded command steps without translating flags between providers.

tools.name: worlds_list_cli_versions
tools.description: Return the exact release snapshot, capture date, factual entity counts, official sources, generated website reference, and drift status for all three CLIs.

tools.name: worlds_list_cli_models
tools.description: Return dated, source-grounded model catalogs for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build, including selector syntax, per-model effort support, availability constraints, and provider-native orchestration modes. These are snapshots; verify the live account catalog before launch.

tools.name: worlds_plan_cli_work
tools.description: Create a read-only, dependency-aware work plan across Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build. It selects a concrete dated-catalog model and supported native effort for each workstream, while keeping CLI fit, orchestration, permissions, handoff context, and verification separate. Routing is continuity-fi

tools.name: worlds_advise_hard_problem
tools.description: Choose the maximum-depth model-and-effort pairing for one difficult problem within the caller's actual CLI set. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "worlds_search_knowledge" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the multilingual Claude World, GPT World, and Grok World corpus. The default core scope is balanced at 18 CLI modules per product in each locale, so Claude archives cannot dominate retrieval. Request curriculum for provider-specific advanced lessons, editorial-archive for historical releases " → after: "Search 162 multilingual, source-checked operating manuals for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build: 18 CLI usage and feature modules per product in English, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese. Website articles, news, newsletters, opinion, and release archives are not in this corpus. Returns bounded exc"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
